bettergregtechponder.ponder.chemical_rea: The panel is the machine's own UI, without the player inventory.
64 grass blocks go into slot 1 and 64 glass into slot 2; the panel shows the machine's real inventory.
Fluids work the same way: tank 0 fills from 0 to 1000 mB in one second.
Covers can be put on a chosen side as well: a conveyor on top.
The model can be switched between working and idle: only the front overlay changes, the recipe logic is left alone.
One recipe id does the rest: the panel fills the inputs, sets the circuit it needs, runs while the bar moves, then drops the product in.
Auto-output sides are machine state as well: items leave through the west side, fluids through the south side.
showFullUI() draws GT's whole UI, and each switch in that configurator column can be boxed on its own: power, auto-output, the circuit setting.
